contexts.text: It has been done of the Lord's Divine Providence that each thing in (the Books of the Prophets of the Old Testament) was counted. This was done by the Masorites. (See also LJ 41:end. DP 260:3.)
From these things it is evident that it has been done of the Lord's Divine Providence that all the letters of the Word in the Hebrew Text have been counted by the Masorites.
